title: Cover-local detection of unbounded derived module isomorphisms
statement: Let C be a category, J a Grothendieck topology, and R a sheaf of rings. Assume abelian sheafification and locally bijective sheafification equivalences on J and its slice sites. Use the ordinary unbounded derived categories of R-modules and of their restrictions [def-weil-pbc-ringed-derived-restriction]. If a morphism a in D(R) has the following property, then a is an isomorphism: for every V in C there is a J-covering sieve S on V such that restriction of a to C/W is invertible for every arrow W to V in S. The object, morphism, coefficient and derived localization universes may be independent.

source.place: Tag 0944 (lemma-projection-formula), first locality sentence, together with exact restriction and cohomology detection.

proof.text: Choose a covering sieve S(V) for every V. Index a family W by pairs of an object V and an arrow of S(V), taking the domain of that arrow. The sieve generated by this family contains S(V) on every V and therefore covers V.
Restriction is exact. For every integer n use its natural comparison with derived cohomology to transfer the assumed invertibility of the restricted derived arrow to the restriction of H^n(a).

Forget the cohomology map to abelian sheaves. Its restriction to every object in the covering family is invertible, so the sheaf gluing isomorphism criterion makes the global sheaf map invertible. The forgetful functor from modules reflects isomorphisms.
All integer cohomology maps are invertible. The unbounded derived isomorphism criterion now makes a invertible; no uniform cohomological bound is used.

proof_origin.place: Explicit realization of Step 5 of the parent proof using exact-functor cohomology comparison and sheaf gluing.

theorem ringedRestrictionLocalIso
    {C : Type c} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (R : Sheaf J RingCat.{r})
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{r}] [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{r}]
    [∀ V : C, HasSheafify (J.over V) AddCommGrpCat.{r}]
    [∀ V : C, (J.over V).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{r}]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{r} R)]
    [∀ V : C, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{r} (R.over V))]
    {A B : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{r} R)} (a : A ⟶ B)
    (h : ∀ V : C, ∃ S : Sieve V, S ∈ J V ∧
      ∀ (W : C) (f : W ⟶ V), S f →
        IsIso ((ringedDerivedRestrictionGeneral R W).map a)) : IsIso a
